rows.name: RIVER THAMES Northfleet
rows.description: Bright light in fairway of Northfleet Hope and Gravesend Reach; red over anchorage in Gravesend Reach and Broadness..

rows.name: Mucking Flat
rows.description: On piles; bright East of N.E. by E., red to W.; also red ray toward Blyth buoy to S. ½ E., and red N. of E.S.E. to clear Scars and Chapman Head. Fog Bell

rows.name: Chapman Head
rows.description: On piles. Bright in fairway channel, red over Leigh Middle to N. of S.E. by E. ½ E. A fog-bell

rows.name: Sheerness
rows.description: Red gas lt. on N.W. face of fort on Garrison Point. Not vis. S. of N.N.W. bearing

rows.name: Queenborough
rows.description: 1. Two red leading lights on pier 2. A bright lt., vis. through 45°, is shown from beacon on Queenborough Spit, in 6 ft. water, 80 yds. S.W. from Spit buoy

rows.name: Whitstable
rows.description: Bright fixed light on tall chimney

rows.name: NORE LIGHTVESSEL
rows.character: One br. rev. lt. ½ min.
rows.description: In 3½ fathoms at East end of the Nore Sand. Gong; warning gun

rows.name: Girdler Lightvessel
rows.character: One br. rev. lt. ½ min.
rows.description: In 3½ fathoms W. Girdler Sand at W. entrance of Princes Channel. Gong; warning gun

rows.name: Princes Channel Lt.-ves.
rows.description: In 3½ fathoms N. side of channel, between Girdler and Tongue Lightvessels. Gong; warning gun.

rows.name: Tongue Lightvessel
rows.character: Upper br., lower red, fixed lights
rows.description: In 10 fms. at East Tongue Sand; one red ball. Lts. at unequal heights. Gong. Warning-gun. (Run into and sunk in July, 1877. Wreck marked by lt.-ves., 1½ cable N.N.E. from it, and buoy S.S.W. from it. Keep outside buoy and lightvessel)

rows.name: Margate Pier
rows.description: Column at W. end of Pier; also a small green light on Jarvis Jetty

rows.name: Mouse Lightvessel
rows.description: In 4 fathoms, at West end of Sand. Gong; warning gun

rows.name: Maplin Pile Lighthouse
rows.description: Painted red; lt. not vis. over the sand; a br. ray to S. ¾ W. betw. Girdler Lt. & Shivering Sand buoy. Br. lt. shown 13 ft. below main lt. to S.E. by E. ¾ E. over Spit buoy. Fog-bell

rows.name: Swin Middle Lightvessel
rows.description: In 5½ fathoms at West end of Sand. Gong; warning gun

rows.name: Gunfleet Pile Lighthouse
rows.character: One red rev. lt. ½ min.
rows.description: On S.E. side of Sand; keep ½ mile off, and do not pass to North. Fog-bell
